headlines.description: — Esmerlyn Valdez tripled, singled and knocked in two runs, Endy Rodriguez and Nick Gonzales homered and the Pittsburgh Pirates beat the Philadelphia Phillies 6-1 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Valdez helps Pirates beat Phillies 6-1 to split their four-game series

headlines.description: — Jake McCarthy drove in four runs, Mickey Moniak had two RBI and finished a triple shy of a cycle, and the Colorado Rockies beat the Miami Marlins 14-4 on Thursday to earn a split in the four-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rockies erupt for 14-4 win over the Marlins, fueled by a 7-run sixth

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Brayan Rocchio hit a two-run homer in the bottom of the ninth inning that gave the Cleveland Guardians a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox on Thursday night in the opener of a four-game series between the top two teams in the AL Central.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brayan Rocchio hits 2-run homer in 9th to lift Guardians over White Sox 6-5 in AL Central showdown

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Jordan Walker homered and drove in four runs, Nathan Church hit a tying two-run homer in a seven-run seventh inning and the St. Louis Cardinals beat the Atlanta Braves 11-5 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walker, Church and Burleson hit homers and Cardinals ride 7-run 7th inning to 11-5 win over Braves

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Cedric Mullins hit a two-run homer, Ian Seymour dominated the Royals for the second time in a week, and the Tampa Bay Rays beat Kansas City 5-2 on Thursday night to extend their winning streak to eight games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mullins' 2-run homer, Seymour's sharp outing lift Rays to 8th straight win, 5-2 over Royals

headlines.description: — Nathan Eovaldi weathered a three-run Detroit uprising after taking a no-hitter into the fifth inning and Elias Díaz, Josh Smith and Evan Carter hit solo home runs to help the Texas Rangers beat the Tigers 10-4 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eovaldi takes a no-hitter into the 5th inning in the Rangers' 10-4 win over the Tigers

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Bryce Miller took a no-hitter into the seventh inning and the Seattle Mariners edged the Los Angeles Angels 1-0 on Thursday night to...
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryce Miller carries no-hitter into 7th and Mariners top Angels 1-0 to complete series sweep

events.name: San Diego Padres at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Dalton Rushing tied career highs with four hits and four RBI as the Los Angeles Dodgers rallied from an early six-run deficit for a 12-7 victory over the skidding San Diego Padres on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dodgers erase early 6-run deficit and win 12-7 to extend Padres' losing streak
